Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & SDK / function-calling next steps

Thanks again for taking time today — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Summary of pain & goals (from your side)
- Primary pain: unpredictable latency for chat features and high token spend on reranking flows.
- Goal: 75% reduction in tail latency for chat (95th pct) and 4x cost improvement for candidate reranking.
- Constraints: must work in VPC, SSO via Okta, and meet SOC 2 evidence requirements for audit.

Product & integration fit (what we covered)
- SDK changes: minimal client changes required — our updated JS/Go SDK exposes function-calling hooks and streaming primitives.
- Function calling: Redwood can support structured output and deterministic function schemas for entity extraction and action generation.
- Streaming: token-by-token streaming available for UI latency improvements; can be combined with prefix caching to reduce compute.
- Embeddings/reranking: recommend dense embeddings + Redwood-hosted ANN for nearest-neighbor candidate pruning, then light reranker on 4-8 top candidates.

Technical asks we noted from the call
1) Example function schema and an ETA for a sample implementation (you asked for a PoC with your QA flows).
2) Expected resource footprint for streaming + reranker at 50 req/s steady state.
3) SOC 2 evidence for data retention and audit logs (you requested a checklist).

Attachments we shared
- redwood-integration-diagram.png (high level architecture)
- mutual-action-plan-acme.xlsx (timeline + owners)
- sdk-function-calling-notes.pdf (API snippets + migration notes)

Proposed next steps
- Vivek (SE) to prepare a short PoC plan and sample function schema by Mon 10 Aug. (owner: Vivek)
- Redwood to share estimated infra footprint & cost delta for streaming + reranker by Tue 11 Aug. (owner: Ethan)
- ACME to provide a representative QA prompt set & sample logs for throughput sizing by Wed 12 Aug. (owner: Olivia)
- Schedule a 45-min technical PoC kickoff the week of Aug 17 — propose Tue 18 Aug 10:00am PT.

If that all looks right I’ll lock in the calendar invite and get the PoC plan started. Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Olivia — quick technical notes on your questions below.

1) Function schema validation: Redwood enforces schema validation server-side at the inference layer when you register a function schema. The runtime will reject or coerce outputs that don’t match the schema (configurable - strict vs best-effort). We can provide an example JSON Schema and an OpenAPI-like contract for your engineers.

2) Streaming + function-calling: yes — streaming and function triggering are compatible. Typical pattern: stream tokens to the UI while monitoring for a schema-complete signal; once the function trigger conditions are met we emit the structured call payload. We can also buffer and emit partial structured data if you’d prefer progressive function outputs.

3) Cost/footprint estimate (very rough OOM for 50 req/s with a lightweight reranker):
- Steady-state GPU type: 1x A100-ish equivalent per 40-60 concurrent generation streams (depending on sequence length).
- Memory: expect ~100-150GB of aggregate memory for caching + reranker state in the baseline PoC.
- Token compute delta: reranker on top of embeddings adds ~15-25% token CPU/GPU overhead vs generation-only flows.
- Ballpark monthly infra delta: $8k–$16k USD for the PoC footprint at 50 req/s (depends on region & reserved capacity discounts).

I’ll formalize these numbers in a short sizing doc and include a few configuration options (dedicated vs shared, quantization profiles).

Action items: Vivek will share PoC plan + example schema by Mon 10 Aug; Ethan will follow up with a refined cost estimate Tue 11 Aug.

Happy to hop on a quick technical sync prior to the kickoff if you want — open this week in the mornings PT.
